messages.content: You can call create_event to add an appointment to the user's calendar.
Add a meeting with the marketing team tomorrow at 2 PM for one hour in the main conference room.

message.content:
<think>The user wants to schedule a meeting with the marketing team tomorrow at 2 PM for one hour in the main conference room.

Tomorrow's date would be: 2024-12-06
2 PM = 14:00

So the start time would be: 2024-12-06T14:00:00

Duration: 1 hour = 60 minutes

Let me create this event:
- Title: "Marketing team meeting" (or similar)
- Start: 2024-12-06T14:00:00
- Duration: 60 minutes
- Location: Main conference room
- Attendees: marketing team (I'll include as "marketing team" or a generic marketing email)
</think>


<minimax:tool_call>
<invoke name="create_event">
<parameter name="title">Marketing team meeting</parameter>
<parameter name="start_iso">2024-12-06T14:00:00</parameter>
<parameter name="duration_minutes">60</parameter>
<parameter name="location">Main conference room</parameter>
</invoke>
</minimax:tool_call>
